data_quality.label_rule: immature and discontinuity rows have NaN labels and are excluded from every rate; none is counted as a negative

survivorship_empirical.note: the 'listed_later' cohort is the only visible difference in the data; companies that stopped trading before 2025 are absent entirely and cannot be examined

forward_report.caution: forward windows are short; counts are tiny and clustered in a few market days; nothing here is evidence of an effect
forward_report.definition: canonical label: entry at the next open, 1R = 2 x recorded ATR14, tiers 3R / 5R / 10R, horizons 20 / 60 / 120 bars, MFE only; no realised strategy return is mixed in

h120.maturity_dates_are_approximate: business days from the last stored bar; exchange holidays are not modelled

h20.maturity_dates_are_approximate: business days from the last stored bar; exchange holidays are not modelled

h60.maturity_dates_are_approximate: business days from the last stored bar; exchange holidays are not modelled

labels.rule: an incomplete horizon is not yet known: it has no value, is excluded from every rate and is never counted as a negative outcome

H1.note: Supported (historical) is hypothesis-generation or replication evidence on data that has been examined before; it is not an edge and earns a forward test only.

e_survives_matching_and_within_date_test.note: a hypothesis about a property of the DATE (H2) has no within-date contrast, so the criterion cannot be met; it is reported as not estimable, not as a negative finding

interval_method: month-block bootstrap, Hall expanded percentile interval (percentile levels widened for the number of month clusters M: alpha' = Phi(sqrt(M/(M-1)) * t_{M-1}(alpha/2))); measured null coverage 95.5% at M=24 vs 93.7% for the plain percentile interval
